svg.title: RE Admin Detailed File Hierarchy and Data Flow
svg.desc: Detailed hierarchy and data flow diagram for the client and server files in the RE Admin project.
svg.text: RE Admin File Hierarchy and Detailed Data Flow
The diagram keeps hierarchy and arrows separate from descriptions. Numbered connectors match the descriptions table at the bottom.

g.text: client/ runs the browser interface. server/ runs the Express API and database access.
Data starts in client components, travels through server route files, then returns as UI output.
Browser-side React application. It owns routing, forms, page components, visual assets, and fetch requests.
Inputs: user clicks, typed form values, and URL parameters. Outputs: rendered UI and HTTP requests.
Node/Express API. It owns middleware, route files, schema helpers, MongoDB connection, and responses.
Inputs: request bodies and route params. Outputs: JSON, status codes, and database reads/writes.
CENTER FLOW LANE: DATA MOVES BETWEEN CLIENT FILES AND SERVER FILES
Full descriptions are in the table below.
Connection Descriptions: How File Names Connect as Data Flows Through the Hierarchy
client/src/main.jsx imports client/src/App.jsx so routed pages can share the App layout.
client/src/App.jsx imports client/src/components/Navbar.jsx and renders it above Outlet.
main.jsx maps / to client/src/components/RecordList.jsx inside App.jsx.
main.jsx maps /create and /edit/:id to client/src/components/Record.jsx inside App.jsx.
client/src/index.css and client/src/App.css provide styling used by rendered React files.
server/server.js imports server/routes/users.js and mounts it at /users.
server/server.js imports server/routes/record.js and mounts it at /record.
server/routes/record.js imports createAgent and updateAgent from agent.schema.js.
server/db/connection.js exposes agentsDb, which points to MongoDB agents.agents.
server/db/connection.js exposes usersDb, which points to MongoDB users.users.
Login.jsx sends POST /users/login; server.js routes it into users.js.
users.js uses usersDb from connection.js to findOne({ email }) in users collection.
users.js returns 200 or 401; Login.jsx navigates to / or /unauthorized.
RecordList.jsx sends GET /record/; server.js routes it into record.js.
record.js uses agentsDb from connection.js to read all documents in agents collection.
record.js returns the agent array; RecordList.jsx renders rows in the table.
Record.jsx sends GET /record/:id; record.js converts params.id into ObjectId.
record.js returns one agent document; Record.jsx fills the edit form with that data.
Record.jsx sends POST /record with form JSON to create a new agent.
record.js passes POST data through createAgent() in agent.schema.js.
createAgent() normalizes rating/fee numbers and adds sales: 0 before insertOne().
Record.jsx sends PATCH /record/:id; record.js passes form data through updateAgent().
updateAgent() builds the editable field set before updateOne({ _id }, { $set }).
RecordList.jsx sends DELETE /record/:id; record.js calls deleteOne({ _id }).
The delete result returns; RecordList.jsx removes the row from component state.
public/rocketLogo.png is referenced by Navbar.jsx and Login.jsx using /rocketLogo.png.
client/public/favicon files and icons.svg are static browser assets served by Vite.
client/src/assets files are bundled assets available to imported React source files.
server/config.env provides ATLAS_URI and PORT used when starting server/server.js.
server/seed.js is a support script for database seed data, separate from live request flow.
package.json files describe dependencies used by client source files and server source files.
